events.title: FTSE 100 Up 0.6% At Noon; Miners, Bank Stocks Move Higher
events.description:
Despite data showing an acceleration in the nation's consumer price inflation in the month of August, U.K. stocks gained notable ground in positive territory on Wednesday thanks to strong buying in mining and bank stocks.

Easing oil prices and lower global bond yields helped lift sentiment.

events.title: Indian Shares End Modestly Higher As Oil Prices Ease
events.description: Indian shares ended Wednesday's session modestly higher as oil prices pulled back from recent highs and investors braced for a closely watched Federal Reserve rate decision later in the day.

events.title: CAC 40 Modestly Higher As Weak Oil Prices Aid Recovery
events.description:
Thanks to easing crude oil prices and lower bond yields, France's equity benchmark CAC 40 edged higher on Wednesday, recovering from a four-month low it touched in the previous session.

However, the mood remained somewhat cautious as investors looked ahead to the Federal Reserve's monetary policy announcement, due later in the day.

events.title: Eurozone Industrial Production Shrinks For Second Month
events.description: Eurozone industrial production declined for the second straight month in July, reflecting a weak start to the third quarter, official data revealed Wednesday. Industrial output edged down 0.1 percent in July, after falling at the same pace in June, Eurostat reported. Production was expected to decline 0.2 percent.

events.title: German Stocks Gain Ground On Oil Decline, Fed Looms
events.description: German stocks recovered Wednesday after two days of losses, with the DAX edging higher as investors awaited the Federal Reserve's interest rate announcement. Oil prices eased and bond yields declined despite lingering Middle East concerns.

events.title: Gold Climbs On Easing Dollar, Softer Crude Prices
events.description: Gold prices advanced on Wednesday as oil prices pulled back from recent highs and investors braced for a closely watched Federal Reserve rate decision later in the day.

events.title: Oil Prices Edge Lower As Supply Concerns Ease
events.description: Oil prices traded lower on Wednesday after industry data showed an unexpected build in U.S. crude inventories and reports emerged that Saudi Arabia is offering more crude oil to Asian refiners through ship-to-ship transfer off Oman's Sohar port.

events.title: European Shares Hold Steady Ahead Of Fed Decision
events.description: European stocks held steady on Wednesday as the recent rally in crude oil prices paused, and bond yields eased from recent highs ahead of the Federal Reserve's interest-rate decision later in the day.

events.title: Asian Shares Reverse Losses As Oil Slips On US Stock Build
events.description: Asian stocks ended flat to slightly higher in cautious trade on Wednesday as oil prices pulled back from recent highs and investors braced for a closely watched Federal Reserve rate decision later in the day.

events.title: Pound Slides Despite U.K. CPI Rise
events.description: The British pound weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday, despite the release of the United Kingdom (UK) Consumer Price Index (CPI) report of August.

events.title: Pound Slides Against Majors
events.description: The British pound weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday.

events.title: European Shares Set For Firm Open Ahead Of Fed Verdict
events.description: European stocks are seen opening a tad higher on Wednesday ahead of the U.S. Federal Reserve's interest-rate decision later in the day, with markets pricing in a 92.4 percent chance of a 25-bps rate hike in response to a recent hot inflation report.

events.title: Indian Shares Modestly Higher In Cautious Trade
events.description: Indian shares were modestly higher on Wednesday after falling sharply in the previous session on concerns over rising oil and U.S. bond yields amid escalating Middle East tensions.
